html:
The Blue Horde was one of the two wings of the Golden Horde, the Mongol state founded by the descendants of Jochi. On the map for 1400 it is the western wing, the lands of Batu from the Dnieper to the Volga; the other wing was the White Horde. Sources disagree which colour meant which wing.

Around 1400 the horde had just lived through ruin. Tokhtamysh had reunited both wings and burned Moscow in 1382, but then turned on his former patron Timur, who defeated him in 1391 and 1395 and sacked its cities, including Sarai. Real power passed to the general Edigu, who ruled through puppet khans and in 1399 crushed a Lithuanian army on the Vorskla river. In the 1400s the horde broke into the khanates of Kazan, Crimea and Astrakhan.
